strings.draw: No moves remain. Each player earns 150 points.
strings.ended: The host ended this match. Points already earned stay.
strings.hint: Close a box to move again.
strings.boardLabel: A little line goes a long way
help: Tap the gap between two dots to draw a line.
The fourth side claims a box and gives you another move. One line can claim two boxes.
Most boxes wins. Equal box counts share a place. With two players, a tie earns 150 each.
The first four seats play; the rest watch. Leaving or running out of move time forfeits your seat.
